title: Linear [HgSe]2 clusters as a route to optical anisotropy and broad infrared transparency
core_idea: Explore the design and synthesis of an Hg-based chalcogenide containing aligned linear [HgSe]2 multinuclear clusters as structural units, and use structural characterization and theoretical analysis of polarizability anisotropy to investigate whether such linear Hg clusters can enable simultaneous large optical anisotropy and broad mid-to-far-infrared transparency.
tldr: This study investigates an Hg-based chalcogenide that incorporates well-aligned linear [HgSe]2 clusters, combining synthesis, structural analysis and theory to propose linear Hg multinuclear clusters as bifunctional building blocks for achieving strong birefringence together with wide infrared transparency in photonic materials.
